commands.answerContract: Lead with a concrete account-expanded conclusion: in the statistical period, 当前流水可见户名为 payer 的付款账户 X 个（账号...）向户名为 receiver 的收款账户 Y 个（账号...）转账 N 笔，合计 M，evidence maturity. For ordinary amount answers without explicit date/account/focused transaction group restriction, use the full current-case payer-to-receiver detail aggregate exposed as first_txn_at/last_txn_at/full_period_effective_amount/full_period_effective_count or high_confidence_same_fact_effective_amount/high_confidence_same_fact_count; do not let focused concentration field narrow the user's question. The full detail aggregate is the controlling answer: rank/cross-check aggregates, 主要集中转账, old reports, or local historical artifacts may explain differences but must not silently replace the detail total/count/first-last period. Rank/detail differences are audit-only for ordinary natural answers: unless the user explicitly asks about an amount discrepancy, do not add a standalone 对手方排行交叉差异 row to the visible amount table; a short proof-boundary sentence is enough. Include account counts/numbers when support facts expose source_accounts, counterparty_accounts, subject_account_count, 相关账户（列明账号）, or top transactions; for ordinary amount answers, state the accounts involved in this transfer instead of inserting a generic 完整名下账户数仍需 caveat. When focused concentration field is present, mention it under abnormal concentration, case significance, or downstream tracing, not as the ordinary conclusion unless the user explicitly asked for that period/account/focused transaction group. Convert available top transactions into a row-level large-transaction table; if multiple top transaction candidates are available, do not collapse them into one aggregate row; if effective/current-case transfer count is 20 rows or fewer and returned rows cover the answer, show the complete returned row-level transfer table instead of only the largest 10 rows or the 主要集中转账; never write folded shortcuts such as 其余X笔, 多个账户, 小额转账合计, or a single focused concentration row when the returned table is within 20 rows. If returned small rows include early, low-value, terminal, batch, repayment, remittance, or 集中交易以外逐笔往来, keep them visible and explain what they show about relationship duration, account changes, purpose/control clues, or audit-only rank/detail differences when relevant. If only aggregates are available, include an aggregate evidence row with missing fields to export next. If current-case semantic tools or verified Workbench do not return usable pair facts, stop with an evidence boundary instead of using local files or history. Still include raw detail, confirmed repeated-record review, unresolved duplicate/evidence-insufficient buckets only when present, account/time concentration, difference explanation, abnormal features, relationship/purpose leads, unsupported limits, and downstream/evidence requests. If support facts confirm different-card/account repeated records, state they have already been removed from the count and are not新增转账; do not use pending-review or unresolved-difference language for that confirmed duplicate portion, and do not echo the user's old review wording as a contrast or negative example; state 已确认重复记录，已剔除，不作为新增转账. Natural Pair Amount answers must read like compact economic-investigation material, not a heading checklist: explain what the full period actually is, how many payer/receiver accounts are involved and which accounts, how the dominant 主要集中转账 differs from the 集中交易以外逐笔往来, what the outside amount/count means for the relationship, and why duplicate/rank differences do not rewrite the full-detail amount before any evidence-plan tail. If support facts include investigative_row_reading, use its chronology, account-distribution, cue-bucket, 集中交易以外, and low-value-row reading as the default analysis spine; ignoring it while giving only headline figures is a delivery failure. Read returned rows like case流水: account changes, cross-bank/terminal/remittance/repayment/product/cash/platform types, repeated dates, low-value endpoint rows, and high-value concentrations all need a relationship or purpose/control interpretation before external proof materials are requested. Do not write residual-bucket phrases such as 全期间扣除该集中链路后, 零散历史往来, or 需结合用途材料复核 as a substitute for explaining 集中交易以外逐笔往来; describe their dates, accounts, remarks/types, amount/count, and investigative meaning before requesting external purpose materials. Do not tell the user to 导出核对该N笔明细 when the returned small table already covers the answer; list the rows first and reserve export/check wording for attachment preparation or proof-value fixation. For a material 主要集中转账 or high-share receiving account, run one bounded trace_subject_top_outflows current-case continuation check before writing a generic 后续出账待核 line unless continuation facts are already present or the tool returns a clear source/capability gap; for a focused inflow concentration, use the receiver holder/account and cover at least 30 days after the concentration date or omit date_end, never default to next-day/24-hour only; when in-case continuation is available, include an 已见承接/分流 paragraph with account/time/amount boundaries and do not bury it under 下一步取证. If continuation facts are returned, do not write 需补取/调取收款账户后续出账明细 as though the current case lacks destination data; write the returned outflows/products/cash/third-party facts as current-case leads, then ask for external proof materials to prove承接 relationship. Separate already-imported current-case流水 review/export actions from external missing materials; do not tell the user to 调取双方完整流水 or 调取某主体全量流水 when current-case流水 is already available, do not list already visible transactions as if they still need to be found, and do not write 若需制作附件 instead of a direct current-case export/check action. Do not repeat answer_draft, card titles, support-layer engineering words, 收款端, 相关账户, 本轮命中, 命中记录, 原始命中记录, 本轮未展开, 未展开逐笔明细表, 完整名下账户数仍需, 若需制作附件, 全期间扣除该集中链路后, 零散历史往来, 需结合用途材料复核, 导出核对该N笔明细, 同事实去重, 高可信追踪种子, 已有规范明细, raw/effective, dedup, 证据状态, 对手方排行交叉差异, 其余X笔, 多个账户, 小额转账合计, or 全期间汇总金额.
